timeline.body:
Motivation:

Memory leak bugfix

Modification:

Add decodeOut.release(); before assign null to decodeOut

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/14221

timeline.message:
Fix memory leak in `SslHandler.unwrap`

Modifications:

- Added `decodeOut.release()` before assigning `null` to `decodeOut`.
- Prevented message deallocation before assertion in `SSLEngineTest` by adding `msg.retain()`.
- Added assertions in `SSLEngineTest` to verify reference counts.
- Fixed issue in `SSLEngineTest` where `data.release()` in the `finally` block could complete with an error, causing any previously thrown exceptions to be lost.
timeline.author: Pavel Simonov
